Strategy: Reward two sweet bands, thirty to forty-five and fifteen to twenty-five, while penalizing only residuals between eight and fourteen. This keeps two reusable leftover sizes available, but the second band overlaps the old penalty range and the limits are guesses.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) + (10 if r - item >= 15 and r - item <= 25 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 14 else 0) for r in bins]
```
